label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 124A

obligations.text:
Other codes of practice
(1)
The Commission must prepare appropriate codes of practice giving guidance as to good practice in the processing of personal data if required to do so by regulations made by the Secretary of State.

(2)
Regulations under this section—
(a)
must describe the personal data or processing to which the code of practice is to relate, and
(b)
may describe the persons or classes of person to whom it is to relate.

(4)
Before preparing a code or amendments under this section, the Commission must consult the Secretary of State and such of the following as the Commission considers appropriate—
(a)
trade associations;
